_note: Animation/rig settings per archetype and species. Motion values are animation choices (timing, amplitude), not biology; biology (locomotion, wings, limb count) still comes from canonical data or asset-overrides.json. heightM is only set where the project already fixes a size.

fileNameAliases._note: Filename token -> canonical species id, for names used in requests/files that differ from the id. sproutling: name used for sprout in the U1-CHAR.4 request.

motionDefaults._note: U1-CHAR.7 pipeline defaults (no GDD value), exported to rig.json motion and the catalog. U1-CHAR.7b: the nominal in-place swim/fly speed comes from the Strouhal number (strouhal) of the stroke measured on each model (cruising animals 0.2-0.4); swim/flyLengthsPerCycle are only the fallback when there is no stroke tip bone. The air turn limit is derived per model from a coordinated turn at maxBankDeg (= MotionShapeSolver.MaxBankDeg); ground/water turn limits stay defaults. Sources: BIOMECHANICS_RESEARCH.md. Art director to confirm.

emberling.heightSource: species-character-spec.json prototypeAsset: EmberlingRefinedGLB.fbx (0.90 m); DragonCarePreview keeps the authored 0.90 m mesh

_changes.U1-CHAR.7b: Biomechanics (Assets/Dravio/Character/BIOMECHANICS_RESEARCH.md): quadruped/winged walk and run period from Alexander's stride/h = 2.3 Fr^0.3 at the authored stride (cadence: froude; frames is the fallback); takeoff.launchShare 0.9 (leg-driven launch: birds get 80-95 % of lift-off velocity from the legs); land.flarePitch 0.3 rad (pitch-up braking; pigeons tilt the stroke plane about 17 deg); swim/fly nominal speed from Strouhal 0.3 on the measured stroke tip; air turn limit from a coordinated turn at maxBankDeg; swim keeps lengthsPerCycle when the measured tail amplitude is outside the fish band swimAmplitudeBandL (flagged for review). magma run.liftLegs 0.24 (fit on the SAMPLE block mesh: the shorter Run cycle sampled a Run pose at 1.601 stretch, limit 1.6). Strides, other amplitudes and QA thresholds unchanged.
